dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: I'm Yi Zhu. You probably know my little sister, Yi Xian?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: I promised Yi Xian that we would make a Xiao Lantern together for Mommy, but I couldn't gather the materials we needed. Thankfully, Changshun specially set aside some materials for us to use...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Everyone's been so good to me and my sister... *sniff*

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: *sniff* ...No, I can't cry... I can't let Yi Xian see me unhappy.
